title: Coin Change II
summary: Count the different handfuls of coins, with unlimited coins of each value, that add up to an exact amount.
followUps: What if the order of the coins mattered, so that 5 + 3 and 3 + 5 counted as two ways?
What if each coin value could be used at most once?
What if the machine held only a limited number of coins of each value?
